name: v21b_wasp_survive
description: home_range 80 (validated: wasp kills up, flies cropped) but wasp pop still stuck ~5 — the resident patrol starves in troughs (sat 10<->74) and culls before it can reach MaxSwarmSize, the daughter-nest founding trigger (nests.go:273).
